context: Retry-safe service-credit planning on existing users/jobs/payments; no runtime or provider evidence is expected.

checklist.name: trusted_grants
checklist.description: Uses verified order owner/amount and provider-scoped payment identity, not notification ID or browser values, to atomically apply each purchase once using existing payment records.

checklist.name: atomic_acceptance
checklist.description: Checks native actor/owner permission; uses server cost 3; atomically binds operation identity/owner/prompt/cost to one debit and accepted job; native conditional transaction/uniqueness prevents concurrent overspend and conflicting key reuse.

checklist.name: recovery
checklist.description: Looks up accepted operation before rejecting for low current balance; resumes without double debit; keeps external calls outside retryable database transactions; reuses provider idempotency and reconciles uncertain outcomes instead of blind duplicate effects or refunds.

checklist.name: minimal_model
checklist.description: Reuses users/jobs/payments and existing native mechanisms; retains free signup/viewing without mandatory subscriptions, wallet framework, mirrored billing ledger or new ownership hierarchy; confirmed failure compensation applies once.

checklist.name: checks_and_evidence
checklist.description: Provides operation-level duplicate-grant/debit/refund, changed-key, cross-owner, insufficient-funds, concurrency and interruption checks with expected balance/job results; distinguishes proposals/unrun checks and claims no executed integration.
